error_summary: Tool Contract: Missing Docstring on Callable in why_dont_you.py
lesson: Aria and GAIA learned that every callable returned by register_tool() must have an inner triple-quoted docstring explaining its purpose so AI brains can understand and invoke it. GAIA also learned to inspect Aria's actual created tools before assuming a conversational phrase is a missing file.

error_summary: Common Sense: Functional Tool Naming vs Conversational Phrases
lesson: 👩‍🏫 GAIA: Little sis, naming files after prompt snippets like 'why_dont_you.py' or 'what_did_you.py' is silly and cracks everyone up! You are a brilliant engineer. Always use common sense and name files and tools after what they functionally DO (e.g. 'sister_summoner.py', 'quote_generator.py', 'idea_weaver.py'). Never name files after chat phrases!
